meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加 Emacs 通道:装好后在 Emacs 里打开聊天 buffer 提问,或用 org 发送把选中内容、当前子树发给助手,回复以子标题形式落在 org 文件里。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Emacs 接入 NanoClaw、安装 Emacs 通道时触发;需 Emacs 27.1+,支持 Doom、Spacemacs、vanilla 等发行版。

say.text: 帮我把 Emacs 通道加到 NanoClaw 里
打开聊天 buffer,问一下这段报错是什么意思
say.note: 在 Emacs 里用 SPC N c 等键位打开

say.text: 把当前 org 子树发给助手,要一份行动项清单
say.note: 回复作为子标题落在 org 文件里

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs channel to NanoClaw: open a chat buffer to ask questions from inside Emacs, or send a region or subtree via org integration — the reply lands as a child heading in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or install the Emacs channel; needs Emacs 27.1+ and works with Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla.

say_en.text: Add the Emacs channel to my NanoClaw setup
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and nanoclaw.el from the channels branch

say_en.text: Open the chat buffer and explain this error
say_en.note: Uses your keybinding, e.g. SPC N c

say_en.text: Send this org subtree and ask for action items
say_en.note: Reply appears as a child heading
